headline: Names a post office in Bergen, New York, after Barry G. Miller.
what_it_does: This law renames the U.S. Postal Service building at 15 Rochester Street in Bergen, New York, as the Barry G. Miller Post Office. It is a naming law only. It does not change how the post office operates, what services it offers, or what it costs to use.
when_it_takes_effect: The law took effect when it was signed on July 15, 2016.
